Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one full-body static character sprite of Queenie for the 2D fighting game Digital Circus Encore. Original SMG4 crossover: SMG4 · Fusion · Reine de machinima. Reference 1 is Queenie's anatomy, reference 2 is the game's 2D style, reference 3 is SMG4 clothing colors only — do NOT copy frog anatomy.
Original Encore crossover design of Queenie from The Amazing Digital Circus, not a canonical outfit. Keep the recognizable queen-chess-piece silhouette: tall honey-brown turned-wood head with pointed scalloped crown and spherical finial, exactly two protruding white eyes with red-orange irises, heavy wooden eyelids, two black lashes below each eye; no mouth or nose. One continuous tapered chess-piece body with a broad circular base and two completely detached floating white gloves, no arms or legs. Crisp fine dark outlines, polished hand-painted 2D cel shading, detailed yet legible at game scale. Physically redesign Queenie as a chunky stylized machinima chess mascot: crown-shaped head built from glossy honey-orange low-poly toy facets with spherical finial, oversized white eyes with red-orange pupils and black lower lashes embedded in the faceted head. Her continuous chess torso becomes a white-and-cobalt-blue modular camera-machine: glowing soft cyan circular lens embedded in chest, rounded square segments narrowing to a broad circular blue chess plinth, yellow polygonal joints in the body. Two detached floating white block-shaped cartoon gloves with cobalt wrist modules. No arms, legs, hair or human face. A burgundy flexible cape panel wraps the back. This is a physical body redesign, not clothing only, no emitted beams.
Pose and framing: motionless relaxed combat guard three-quarter facing RIGHT. Eyes look right. The full character from spherical finial down to her integrated chess-body base fits inside the frame, with ample clear transparent margins; both detached gloves fully visible. Top-down or perspective tilt forbidden. No animation, action attack or extra views.
Rendering: crisp dark outlines, polished hand-painted 2D cel shading, rich fine detail readable at game scale. Transparent RGBA with no colored halo, glow or drop shadow. Remove any separate commercial black display pedestal. No scene, floor, text, lettering, watermarks, unrelated props or extra figures. ONE character per PNG, portrait 1024x1536 composition.
